findings.title: Potential reentrancy vulnerability
findings.description: External call is performed before state update.
findings.recommendation: Apply checks-effects-interactions pattern or use reentrancy guard.

findings.title: Missing role validation
findings.description: Sensitive function may be callable without sufficient authorization.
findings.recommendation: Restrict sensitive functions using role-based access control.

findings.title: Unchecked external call result
findings.description: Low-level call result is not explicitly validated.
findings.recommendation: Check return value and revert on failed call.

findings.title: Missing event emission
findings.description: Critical state change does not emit an event.
findings.recommendation: Emit an event for better traceability and monitoring.
